authorisation: architect handover12, no StageC execution authorisation
order: D1 then D2, serial; one attempt each, stop on any run failure, no retry
loader: same original I4 manifest and inputs with derived receiving paths/gzip container; verify logical control hash and original inputs/source qualification; call unchanged i4.load and i4.panels only; do not read lambdas or StageB metadata
persistence: Persist regenerated panels BEFORE comparison as UTF8 json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True,allow_nan=False), no newline; SHA256 is both canonical and actual file-byte hash. Preserve original panels/manifest/failure unchanged.

comparison.folds: sorted union of fold keys; key presence then first_gw then squad count
comparison.squads: same squad index and member index in list order; exact id/position/team/price_tenths; report member-ID sets and ensemble set of sorted squad-ID rosters ignoring order
comparison.weights: count numeric inequalities, max absolute difference, max relative difference abs(regenerated-original)/abs(original); 0 vs0 =>0, original0 vsnonzero =>infinite (JSON string Infinity)
comparison.types: report repr and type differences separately, numeric-equal type-only differences do not cause B
comparison.first_difference: deterministic sorted-fold/squad/member/field order; complete repr plus type of both values, no truncation
comparison.missing_structure: report unmatched folds/squads/members and classify B

classes.A: All fold keys, first_gw, squad counts/order, ordered member id/position/team/price_tenths numerically exact; only weight float differences <=1e-9 relative, or hash/type-only differences.
classes.B: Any structural/order/id/position/team/price_tenths/first_gw/count difference, missing member/field, nonfinite float, or weight float relative difference >1e-9.
classes.C: Cannot run: load/source qualification/runtime/guard failure; preserve receipts, no retry.

decision.D1_A: Architect intends to consider original frozen panels as shared fixture, only after handover13 review and new write-once StageC amendment.
decision.D1_B: Architect checks possible cohort/control-feature implications, may require mits-r3 or close package; no inferred authority.
decision.D1_C: Blocker return; no retries or further runs.
decision.all: Engineer stops with handover13; no StageC market rows, feature matrix, fit, prediction, score or panel substitution. Frozen StageC equality rule untouched.

cross_runtime: Compare persisted D1 and D2 panels with same structured comparator (D1 reference); report exact hash/object equality, class equality, structural agreement and weight differences. No additional input-loading run.

resources.guard: unchanged qualified Windows inherited job object; committed-memory cap, sampled wall/growth/free space; no security sandbox claim

excluded: editing StageC protocol or failure evidence
